observations.why: The directive carries a stability-seeking cadence and frames repeated rehearsal as an ongoing capability practice.
The assertion links rehearsal to retaining a reliable capability, making security and mastery explicit rather than merely discussing rollback content.
The standalone label foregrounds regularity and stability as the value dimension of the presented proposal.
The phrase presents recurring practice as a way of maintaining dependable capability; the footing reports the principal's stance.
The role label foregrounds accountable capability and stewardship, though it does not express autonomy or achievement.
Naming the owner assigns capability responsibility to a specific person; this is Xena's reported rendering of the principal's position.
